name: Kanojo wa Toki no Neji o Gyakumuki ni Mawashita
original_name: 彼女は時のねじを逆向きに回した
source:
A boy-meets-retrograding-girl story taking place on the roof.

"I come from the near future."

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/7713]Novel Game Collection[/url]]
translation:
一个发生在屋顶上的故事，少年遇见了逆着时间前行的少女。

“我来自不远的未来。”

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/7713]Novel Game Collection[/url]]
